patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality photography is used extensively for hero sections and large content blocks, often with text overlays for branding and calls to action.

A strong hierarchy is established with large, bold sans-serif headlines for major sections and product categories, complemented by smaller, often uppercase sans-serif text for labels and product details.

The palette features a dominant warm, earthy beige (#e6dbcb) contrasted with deep charcoal/black (#0e0e0b) for text and dark backgrounds, accented by a rich reddish-brown (#bf4940) for calls to action.
The hero image background parallaxes as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth, while the main navigation bar transforms into a sticky, condensed version with a solid background.
Content is organized into distinct, visually impactful sections, often alternating between light backgrounds with product grids and dark, full-width photographic brand story blocks.

technique_notes: The motion system uses CSS keyframes to create a subtle parallax effect on the hero background image, making it scroll slower than the foreground content. The main navigation bar employs a transform and background change to transition from its initial transparent state to a condensed, sticky version with a solid backdrop upon scrolling. A promotional banner is revealed by sliding down from the top of the viewport after a specific scroll depth is reached.

Hero sections utilize large, high-resolution images set as full-bleed backgrounds, with text content positioned centrally and given a strong visual weight through large typography and clear contrast against the image.
Product and category displays are structured in flexible grid layouts, adapting from two to four columns, with each item featuring an image, title, and price, often with a subtle hover effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, legible sans-serif body text, frequently using uppercase for labels and product names.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle: minimal rounding on buttons and image containers, maintaining a generally sharp aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced: generous vertical spacing between sections, with well-defined padding within content blocks and product grids.

standout: This site stands out by masterfully blending rugged, high-quality photography with a refined, modern sans-serif typography. The combination creates a distinctive brand identity that feels both heritage-rich and contemporary, avoiding generic e-commerce aesthetics. The subtle parallax and transforming sticky header add a premium, interactive layer without distracting from the product focus.
